title: Offerings for the Seventh Month

questions.question: What is celebrated on the first day of the seventh month?
options: A day for you to blow the trumpets (Feast of Trumpets)
questions.correctAnswer: A day for you to blow the trumpets (Feast of Trumpets)
questions.explanation: Numbers 29:1 (ESV): "It is a day for you to blow the trumpets."

questions.question: When is the Day of Atonement (afflicting yourselves)?
options: Tenth day of the seventh month
questions.correctAnswer: Tenth day of the seventh month
questions.explanation: Numbers 29:7 (ESV): "On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation and afflict yourselves..."

questions.question: When does the Feast of Booths (Tabernacles) begin?
options: Fifteenth day of the seventh month
questions.correctAnswer: Fifteenth day of the seventh month
questions.explanation: Numbers 29:12 (ESV): "On the fifteenth day of the seventh month..."

questions.question: How many bulls are offered on the first day of the Feast of Booths?
How does the number of bulls change each day during the feast?
options: It decreases by one each day (13, 12, 11...)
questions.correctAnswer: It decreases by one each day (13, 12, 11...)
questions.explanation: Numbers 29:17, 20, 23 etc. show the count going down: 12, 11, 10...

questions.question: On the eighth day of the feast, what is held?
questions.explanation: Numbers 29:35 (ESV): "On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly..."

questions.question: How many bulls are offered on the eighth day?
questions.explanation: Numbers 29:36 (ESV): "One bull, one ram, seven male lambs..."

questions.question: What sin offering was made on the Day of Atonement besides the one for atonement?
questions.explanation: Numbers 29:11 (ESV): "One male goat for a sin offering, besides the sin offering of atonement..."

questions.question: How many days does the Feast of Booths last (including the assembly)?
questions.explanation: Numbers 29:12-38 describes offerings for days 1 through 8.

questions.question: Are vows and freewill offerings included in these commands?
options: These are in addition to vows and freewill offerings
questions.correctAnswer: These are in addition to vows and freewill offerings
questions.explanation: Numbers 29:39 (ESV): "These you shall offer... in addition to your vows and your freewill offerings..."

questions.question: What is the total number of bulls offered over the 7 days of the feast (13+12+11+10+9+8+7)?
What is the drink offering for the goat?
options: Not explicitly detailed in every verse but implied as standard/none
None usually mentioned for sin offering goat here
questions.correctAnswer: None usually mentioned for sin offering goat here
questions.explanation: The text repeatedly says "their grain offering and their drink offerings" for the burnt offerings (bulls/rams/lambs), but the goat is "for a sin offering" usually without separate mention of drink offering in this list.

questions.question: On the seventh day of the feast, how many bulls?
questions.explanation: Numbers 29:32 (ESV): "On the seventh day seven bulls..."

questions.question: Which month has the most detailed offering instructions?
questions.explanation: Chapter 29 is entirely dedicated to the 7th month (Trumpets, Atonement, Booths).

questions.question: Who did Moses tell all these things to?
questions.explanation: Numbers 29:40 (ESV): "So Moses told the people of Israel everything just as the Lord had commanded..."

key_verse_text: These you shall offer to the Lord at your appointed feasts, in addition to your vows and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your grain offerings...
